hypotheses.M0_integrated_sources_recompose_factors: Integrated source effects recompose both factor changes below 2e-5 relative error.
hypotheses.M1_three_sources_explain_each_operand: The median top-three absolute source share of selected edit operands is at least 0.70 in every cell.
hypotheses.M2_frozen_transport_heads_cover_operands: The discovery-frozen three-head set supplies at least 0.50 of selected operand absolute effect in every cell.
hypotheses.M3_layer0_source_roles_are_more_recurren: Layer-0 recurring-channel dominant-source agreement exceeds Layer 1 by at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.M4_layer0_source_roles_transfer_ood: Cross-corpus dominant-source agreement is at least 0.60 at Layer 0 and below 0.60 at Layer 1.
hypotheses.M5_layer1_carried_state_is_material: Carried state supplies at least 0.15 median absolute operand share at Layer 1 on both corpora.
hypotheses.M6_causal_selection_enriches_source_conc: Selected channels exceed fixed-random channels in top-three source share by at least 0.05 in every cell.
